comparison.objective: Draft task unlatches an Ethernet plug in a crowded panel and transfers it to another port; the candidate sets and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2210 requires small spring-tab depression, constrained plug withdrawal/insertion, flexible-cable management, and avoiding neighboring plugs; the candidate requires two-tool threaded counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2210 proposes source release before withdrawal, target seating and latch re-engagement, neighbor retention, and a released hold; the candidate checks angular-stop retention and cycling.
comparison.reason: Connector unlatching and insertion in cable clutter are mechanically and observably different from screw–jam-nut calibration.
